games/death-penalty/index.title: Death Penalty
games/death-penalty/index.content:
Guide 1
Guide 2
Destroying bodies will add negative status effects unless wearing a gas mask.
Destroying bodies does not pause the game. Enemies still move around.

Be very careful destroying bodies if enemies are nearby because they can ambush you mid-animation.


Getting to courtyard:

Go to library.
Use the catgirl painting.
Directions:

 Right
 Up
 Left
 Up
 Left
 Go through the door the Freak is guarding
 All the way left to pick up the courtyard key on the floor next to the Devil


Retrace steps
In the library, go down the broken bars to get to the first hub OR just walk there
Go to the top-left of the first hub to get to the mold rooms
Go to the very top-right of the mold rooms to enter the courtyard


Attack elements of fire and holy both do damage to ghostly enemies.

Throwing weapons are the GOAT.

games/death-penalty/enemies.title: Enemies
games/death-penalty/enemies.content:
Keep in mind that throwing weapons have a really strong AGI modifier. If an enemy has a ludicrous AGI requirement to first-turn-kill, they may still be killable with a throwing weapon.

Rock: +12 AGI.

Note: Single-target. Medium/high damage.


Bwaka Knife: +25 AGI.

Note: AOE, but hits everything. Does basically no damage, but bleeds and stuns.


Throwing Knives: +25 AGI.

Note: Single-target. High damage.


Shuriken: +25 AGI.

Note: Single-target. Very high damage.


Fan Daggers: +50 AGI.

Note: AOE, so might not hit the desired limb(s).
Low damage.


Throwing Daggers +50 AGI.

Note: AOE, so might not hit the desired limb(s).
Medium damage.




Remember that enemies have a defense stat. If it’s high enough, it may screw you out of a decapitation.
